name: handle-layout-2026
summary: Give every Zone.exe object kind the handle range the 2026 client expects, so the client files players, drops, NPCs, doors and the rest under the right kind.
status: Built and verified 2026-09-17; see the README entry for what has been seen live.
why: THE 2026 CLIENT DECIDES WHAT AN OBJECT IS FROM ITS HANDLE ALONE. Fiesta.exe 0x903BC0 splits a u16 handle
into (kind, index) with a chain of literal ranges, and code such as the NC_MAP_LOGOUT_CMD handler
(0x5A0E10) routes on the kind: kind 1 goes to the dropped-item manager, and so on.
The 2016 zone hands handles out in a different layout. 2026 grew the mob range from 8000 to 12000 and
the NPC range from 256 to 1024, which moved every range after them:
kind            2016 zone          2026 client
2  players      0x1F40-0x251C      0x2EE0-0x34BC
3  mini houses  0x251C-0x2904      0x34BC-0x38A4
1  drops        0x2904-0x34BC      0x38A4-0x445C
0  axial flags  0x34BC-0x42BC      0x445C-0x525C
4  NPCs         0x42BC-0x43BC      0x525C-0x565C   (npc-object-pool-cap, handle_base 0x525C)
8  bandits      0x43BC-0x4BBC      0x565C-0x5E5C
9  effects      0x4BBC-0x4FA4      0x5E5C-0x6244
6  magic fields 0x4FA4-0x509E      0x6244-0x633E
11 movers       0x567A-0x5A62      0x691A-0x6D02
So a 2016 player (0x1F4F) and a 2016 drop (0x2908) are both mobs to the 2026 client. Found on a drop:
picking up Void MuruMuru's Energy left it lying on the ground - NC_MAP_LOGOUT_CMD for its handle went to
the mob manager - until a second click drew PICK_ACK error 0x34B, whose handler removes by handle
directly. The same mismatch can misroute anything the client decides by kind.
THE PATCH moves each kind to its 2026 base and keeps its 2016 capacity; every span except the mobs'
is the same on both sides. Mobs stay where they are: their 2016 range already lies inside the 2026 one.
Handle bases live in exactly three kinds of place, found by searching the code section for every base
as an imm32 and as an imm16 (none) - sohu_HandleSplit (0x633650), each kind's sohu_Set<Kind>Handle and
its Shine<Kind>::so_RemakeHandle. sohu_HandleSplit tests both bounds in every block, so blocks move
independently; the players' block tests only its upper bound, and a handle between the old and new
player base now splits to an index past the pool and is refused by som_GetObject, as any stale handle is.
Every subtract written here equals the one in the 2026 client's own table (checked when this file was
generated), and every upper equals the client's.
NEEDS npc-object-pool-cap with --set handle_base=0x525C in the same build: kind 0's range now ends at
0x525C and kind 8 begins at 0x565C. build_zone.py does this.
